scope: Repair the overlapping attachment controls introduced during the October 14 compact composer resize.
reportedSymptom: Remove X overlays the image thumbnail and coincides with the audio/status glyph, including the invalid Beat.wav attachment.
cause: The prior resize reduced Input preview from 112 by 80 to 40 by 40 and positioned every inner instance at the same upper-right anchor. That treated content/status glyphs and remove controls as the same role.
priorVerificationLimitation: The preceding geometry audit did not check sibling-region overlap. Screen contact sheets were too small to expose the attachment collision. Its overall completion claim overstated attachment verification.

repair.layout: Horizontal auto-layout with separate 32px preview/status area, wrapping identity, and trailing 32px desktop remove target. Existing touch attachments retain 44px targets.
repair.identityPreservation: Each instance uses Label#1028:37. Source text and image fills are retained; per-source remove reactions are copied. A missing label binding in the cloned audio variant was caught and repaired during visual verification.

checks: Preview, identity and removal regions do not overlap
All visible attachment content fits within its row
Status glyphs are centered and separate from removal controls
Rendered identity matches the component property
Desktop remove target is at least 32 by 32
Existing touch remove target is 44 by 44 and does not overlap its neighbors

composer.name: Vidra Fresh / Composer shell / Model with inputs

page.name: Page 26 - Vidra public site and account

visualReview.method: Native PNG renders. All source attachments and all affected composer attachment regions inspected at readable size using enlarged close-up sheets; G13, G14 and G15 also inspected as full screens. The latest audio-source and G13/G15 renders follow the label-binding repair.

replay.instructions: Set the current page once, then run this read-only script. Repeat for the page IDs in pageAudits.

boundary: Figma component/layout correction and design evidence only. Application behavior and provider qualification are separate.
